item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=probabilistic+context+free+grammar+uncertainty+metrics+meta+reasoning+loops&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1201/b19269-5\", \"title\": [\"Prior-Free Probabilistic Inference\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1201/b19269-5\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2015, 9, 25]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1109/dcc47342.2020.00093\", \"title\": [\"Grammar Compression with Probabilistic Context-Free Grammar\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1109/dcc47342.2020.00093\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2020, 3]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7519211\", \"title\": [\"Local Reasoning about Probabilistic Programs with Unbounded Loops\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>We propose an assertion-based logic for local reasoning about probabilistic programs that terminate almost surely but may have unbounded loops.Syntactically, by introducing distribution formulas and their extensions, our approach can effectively capture the invariants of unbounded loops, which differs from existing probabilistic program logics with semantic assertions. Assertions connected by separation conjunction are able to express probabilistic independence, which more intuitively highlights mutual independence of variables and enables local reasoning. We formally establish the soundness of the logic. We demonstrate the use of our logic through case studies, including a von Neumann sampler and a Bayesian network inference.Moreover, we have embedded a restricted version of the logic in the theorem prover Rocq.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7519211\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1109/dsd.2017.26\", \"title\": [\"A Probabilistic Context-Free Grammar Based Random Test Program Generation\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1109/dsd.2017.26\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2017, 8]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "7ff3a22a317cb95e35c06cec407ce04352edddbfca3714786f581de452dbf178", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "assumption_challenge", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.1201/b19269-5", "doi:10.1109/dcc47342.2020.00093", "doi:10.2139/ssrn.7519211", "doi:10.1109/dsd.2017.26"], …
